semantics.how: Returns 'present' when dest/.git exists; otherwise runs git clone -b main from the bundle with a fixed argv and no shell, throwing on spawn errors or a non-zero exit
semantics.what: Clones a fixture repo's git bundle into place unless a checkout already exists
semantics.when: Run by npm's pretest hook before every npm run test
semantics.why: fixtures/orderly is a gitignored nested repo whose history tests read, so fresh clones and review worktrees need it rebuilt from the committed bundle
